title: rgb histogram with modes and parade

commit.merge_subject: merge: rgb histogram with modes and parade

description:
Replace the luma-bars overlay with the full RGB histogram display
(owner's 2026-11-11 RGB spec, RapidRAW display study):

- Compact 160x85dp panel (unchanged footprint) draws the combined
  RGB view: the three channels as filled smoothed curves (literal
  channel colors - the documented roles-never-hex exception: a
  channel's color IS its meaning; RapidRAW-studied values on the
  dark scrim) at 50% alpha with thin crisp outlines, drawn
  blue-green-red so overlaps mix like Lightroom's, plus a subtle
  grey luma outline on top - outline only, never obscuring.
- Tap the graph -> expanded panel with an RGB / Luma / Parade mode
  switch (SegmentedButton; labels stay untranslated product codes)
  and taller graph. Parade = three side-by-side channel cells on
  ONE common scale. Mode + expansion are rememberSaveable inside
  the overlay, so the screen's wiring stays one call.
- Display smooth
changed: feat: rgb histogram overlay with modes
